summary: In Odoo Sales I created a new quotation for customer 'fwod81-n1 Bench Customer' (chosen from the autocomplete dropdown, which then showed its City Benchville) and added ONE order line by picking [FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens from the product dropdown, quantity 3. The live DOM showed the line's unit price auto-filled as £ 295.00 (tax 20%), and the app's subtotal footer computed Untaxed Amount £ 885.00 (TAX 20% £ 177.00, Total £ 1,062.00). Saving succeeded: the URL changed to ...model=sale.order&view_type=form&id=21 with title "Odoo - S00021" and statusbar on "Quotation" — the saved quotation reference is S00021. Not confirmed: I read the unit price and Untaxed Amount on the form before the save click (both were re-rendered correctly immediately after the quantity edit); I did not re-read the footer values after the save, and the product field text was read via the dropdown option label rather than the saved-record field.

summary: On quotation S00021 (id=21, customer fwod81-n1 Bench Customer) I added a second order line by clicking "Add a product" and choosing [E-COM11] Cabinet with Doors from the product dropdown (different from the existing Acoustic Bloc Screens line), set quantity to 2, and saved with the control-panel Save. Note: while setting the quantity I briefly typed into the row's product autocomplete by mistake and immediately re-selected [E-COM11] Cabinet with Doors; the saved line shows the correct product, quantity 2.00 and price 140.00.

summary: Confirmed quotation S00021 (partner fwod81-n1 Bench Customer) — the statusbar then showed 'Sales Order' checked on heading S00021. I then clicked Cancel; Odoo opened the 'Cancel Sales Order' wizard ("Are you sure you want to cancel this order?") and I ran its 'Cancel' (action_cancel) button, which cancelled the order without sending mail. Verified from the live DOM afterwards: heading still S00021 and the statusbar reads "Cancelled / Sales Order / Quotation Sent / Quotation" with 'Cancelled' checked, plus a 'Set to Quotation' button — so nothing remains active. Note: mid-flow a stray 'Edit: fwod81-n1 Bench Customer' modal had opened on top of the wizard, blocking the first click; I dismissed it with Discard and then the cancel action took effect (single cancel, no repeated state change).
